text:
Four students are asked to state and explain the relative magnitudes of the thermal expansion of
solids and gases.
Which student is correct?
A
Gases expand more than solids because the molecules in a gas are in random motion.
B
Gases expand more than solids because the attractive forces between molecules are much
weaker in gases.
C
Solids expand more than gases because the molecules are closer together in solids.
D
Solids expand more than gases because the molecules in a solid are in a regular pattern.
